title: Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication
description: Authentication middleware and handlers for ASP.NET Core applications.

data.text: Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication provides the authentication infrastructure for ASP.NET Core. It supports cookies, JWT Bearer, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, and custom authentication schemes.

data.title: JWT Authentication

terms.definition: A named strategy for authenticating requests.
A token-based authentication scheme using JSON Web Tokens.

data.title: Security
data.text: Always validate tokens server-side and never expose signing keys to clients.

data.title: Key Takeaways
data.takeaway: Use ASP.NET Core Authentication to secure your applications with industry-standard protocols.
